context: A mom and son visit a zoo
purpose: Teach: キリン/ハチ/蜂蜜/前菜/スイーツ/ガッツ/菜の花/リーフ

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、キリン、餌を食べてるよ!
lines.style: Urgent joy bursting out. Sharp attack on the first word, bright and loud. Speaking in real-time observation — barely pausing between words. The excitement of wanting her to see it *now*.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 隣の花壇、ハチが飛んでるから、気をつけてね。
lines.en: Careful near that flowerbed, though — there are bees flying around.
lines.style: Calm, protecting without alarming. Gentle redirect. Steady pace. Soft opener, then a quiet firmness on the warning. The tone of someone whose attention is divided between the moment and what could hurt.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: おうちに帰って、蜂蜜パンケーキ作って!
lines.en: When we get home, can you make honey pancakes?
lines.style: Breathless anticipation. Soft, almost pleading at the edges — he wants this. Quick pace building toward the request. The reaching-out tone of a child who's already daydreaming about it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 前菜にサラダ、用意するね。
lines.en: I'll make a nice salad first.
lines.style: Warm agreement, already planning. Practical and reassuring. Moderate pace. The slight smile in the voice — she's already thinking of what goes with pancakes. A quiet yes to his request.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: デザートのスイーツ、いっぱい食べたい!
lines.en: And I want lots and lots of dessert sweets!
lines.style: Greedy delight. Quick, rising energy. Playful exaggeration on the repetition — not whining, just the pure enthusiasm of a six-year-old who's now daydreaming bigger. Bright attack at the start.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ガッツポーズ、お父さんに見せてあげてね。
lines.en: You'll have to show Dad your victory pose when we get home.
lines.style: Playful, teasing him gently into pride. Light, warm tone. She's building him up. Slight rhythm to it — like she's setting up a game they both understand. Inviting him to be proud.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 菜の花の天ぷら、作れる?
lines.en: Can you make the tempura with nanohana too?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, not demanding. Soft, wondering. He's asking because he trusts she can do it. Slight rise at the end — the real question underneath is *will you?* Not urgent, just hopeful.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。紅茶のリーフ、新しいの淹れようね。
lines.en: Of course. And I'll brew us some fresh tea leaves.
lines.style: Gentle closing affection. Warm, settled. Slower pace here — she's already home with him in her mind. The 'us' is deliberate — including him in the ritual. A quiet promise wrapped in ordinariness.
